name: Argent
description: Records iOS simulators and Android emulators and devices with Argent, on a timer or while replaying a saved flow, and re-shoots a flow's take when the app changes.
author: Software Mansion

agentTools.name: argent_list_devices
agentTools.description: List the simulators, emulators and apps Argent sees, each with recordable (true or false, with the reason). Call it before recording.

agentTools.name: argent_record
agentTools.description: Record a device's screen: replay a saved flow while recording (preferred: repeatable, and it can be re-shot later), or record for a number of seconds. The take is imported into the project as media (its id comes back); place it with timeline_edit.

device.description: A recordable device id from argent_list_devices.

flow.description: A flow to replay while recording: a saved flow's name in the project's flows/ folder, a path relative to the project (flows/login.yaml) or an absolute path to an Argent flow .yaml. The take lasts as long as the flow.

seconds.description: Record for this long instead of replaying a flow.

saveFlow.description: Save the replayed flow in the project's flows/ folder under this name (a flow from elsewhere is always copied there, so the take can be re-shot).

showTouches.description: Draw taps and swipes into the video (default false).

name.description: The take's file and media name.

agentTools.name: argent_reshoot
agentTools.description: Re-record a media item Argent recorded from a flow (its own, or another flow) and swap the new take in everywhere the media is used, as one undoable edit. A shorter take trims the clips that run past its end (overrun hold: they hold its last frame instead); the result lists each with a warning.

flow.description: Replay this flow instead of the one the media was recorded with.

overrun.description: Clips past the new take's end: trim them (default) or hold its last frame.
